title: Living Prism Gear
summary: **Living Prism Gear** is the step above Chromatic: the same armour, tools and weapons, plus wings and the Living Bark set bonus on the armour.

blocks.p: At `/craft`, each Living Prism recipe upgrades a [Chromatic](/wiki/gear/chromatic/) piece into its twin. The Chromatic piece is used up, and its upgrades, Awakening, prefix and enchants carry over, except Thorns. Costs are on [Crafting and Upgrades](/wiki/smp/crafting/).

The [Living Prism Crate](/wiki/smp/crates/) gives every piece. Its keys come from the [Battle Pass](/wiki/smp/battle-pass/), the store and the crate's own milestone. The spear, mace and wings only come from this crate.

ul: {{icon:living_prism_chestplate}} Armour: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, with Living Bark when you wear all four.
{{icon:netherite_sword}} Weapons: sword, spear, mace, bow and crossbow.
{{icon:netherite_pickaxe}} Tools: pickaxe, axe, shovel, harvester and angler.

blocks.p: A new piece comes with these enchants. The bonus is what its lore says.

Living Prism gear stays with you when you die (see [Keep-on-Death Gear](/wiki/smp/keep-on-death/)). At zero durability it shatters instead of breaking and keeps everything on it. Repair it with `/craft repair`.
Each armour piece has a gem socket: see [Amethyst Gems](/wiki/gear/gems/).

ul: Living Prism armour is the recommended gear for the Very Hard areas of [Heartwood](/wiki/smp/dungeons/).
If a Chromatic piece holds more gems than its Living Prism twin has sockets, take the extra out before you upgrade it. The bench refuses otherwise.
